description: GST Compensation Cess — starter set covering commonly-encountered items. NOT exhaustive.
source: GST (Compensation to States) Act 2017; CBIC Notification No. 1/2017-Compensation Cess (Rate) and subsequent amendments. 2025 update: under GST 2.0 the compensation cess was discontinued for all goods EXCEPT the tobacco family with effect from 2025-09-22 — verify the exact notification before production use.
notes: Compensation cess applies in addition to the normal GST rate on specified luxury / sin goods. Rates are often extraordinarily high (motor vehicles, tobacco, aerated beverages, coal) and change with GST Council decisions — verify against current CBIC notifications. Specific / compound cess (ad valorem + per-unit) must be supported by the consuming application. IMPORTANT: under GST 2.0 the compensation cess was discontinued with effect from 2025-09-22 for ALL goods EXCEPT the tobacco family (cigarettes, pan masala / gutkha, chewing tobacco, zarda, bidi). The non-tobacco entries below therefore carry validTo 2025-09-21 so that invoices dated before the cutover still resolve the historical rate while later invoices resolve to no cess. Confirm the exact notification + cutover date. Motor-vehicle cess (1%-22%) depends on engine capacity, length and SUV/category criteria that are NOT encoded in the HSN, so it is a single non-auto-applicable entry (cessRate null) — determine the correct bracket manually from the notification.

entries.note: Plus applicable GST at 28%. Tobacco family — compensation cess continues after the 2025-09-22 cutover.

entries.cessNote: Compound cess: ad valorem percentage plus specific amount per thousand sticks, varies by length and filter/non-filter category. Refer to current notification.
entries.note: Tobacco family — compensation cess continues after the 2025-09-22 cutover.

entries.description: Aerated waters, containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
entries.note: Plus 28% GST. Compensation cess ended 2025-09-22 (GST 2.0). HSN 2202 is broad (includes some non-cess sub-codes such as plain fruit juices) — narrow to the specific aerated/caffeinated sub-headings where precision matters.

entries.description: Motor vehicles (passenger) — cess varies by sub-category
entries.cessNote: Cess ranged from 1% to 22% by engine capacity, length, fuel type and SUV/luxury category — these criteria are not encoded in the HSN, so this entry is NOT auto-applicable; determine the rate manually from the notification.
entries.note: Compensation cess ended 2025-09-22 (GST 2.0). Replaces the previous two ambiguous 8703 entries (1% and 22% on the same HSN).
